correction_to_prior_wording.corrected_wording: The mnemonic/time -> frozen-coordinate branch is not the failed link. The Earth-fixed coordinate is independently anchored by EM12. The unresolved/failing link is frozen Earth-cell -> defensible TOBI feature replication at that same cell.
correction_to_prior_wording.scope: This V3 contract addresses vehicle navigation / footprint provenance only. It does not re-open or move the frozen coordinate.

v3_primary_question: Can CD169 per-ping TOBI position be recovered from an authentic PRISM-derived .veh_nav, an independently archived/calibrated vehicle-navigation product, or the exact PRISM wireout algorithm plus CD169-specific configuration/provenance?

allowed_evidence_lanes.goal: Recover an actual .veh_nav or equivalent archived vehicle-navigation file and hash the original bytes before interpretation.

Inspect CD169 processed PRISM CDF metadata/navigation variables only, determine whether they contain vehicle positions already merged by PRISM, and establish exact provenance before using them as a calibrated navigation product.

Recover exact wireout algorithm/source/manual semantics and CD169-specific parameters/configuration. Generic later-cruise assumptions may constrain the search but may not be silently transferred to CD169.
Explain the two large V2 held-out residuals without deleting them or fitting parameters; separately audit any anchor outside actual raw time support.

Search the user's other JANUS repositories for exact historical bytes, provenance, prior source-recovery methods, or non-mutating diagnostic organs. Same-name PRISM components are not assumed identical.

G3A_NATIVE_VEH_NAV.pass_if: An authentic CD169 .veh_nav or equivalent vehicle-navigation artifact is recovered with original-byte SHA-256 and provenance tying it to CD169/PRISM processing.

G3B_CALIBRATED_NAV_PRODUCT.pass_if: A processed CD169 product contains per-ping vehicle coordinates and provenance establishes that those coordinates are vehicle navigation rather than ship navigation or an unmerged header field.

G3C_EXACT_WIREOUT_REPRODUCTION.pass_if: The exact wireout algorithm/semantics plus CD169-specific configuration are recovered sufficiently to reproduce the archived navigation without fitting to the frozen target or sonar intensity.

G3D_OUTLIER_DIAGNOSTICS.pass_if: Outliers are classified by time support / turn geometry / source disagreement / sensor-quality evidence without deleting observations or tuning parameters.

G3E_FOOTPRINT_RETEST.precondition: G3A or G3B or defensible G3C PASS
G3E_FOOTPRINT_RETEST.rule: Map the already frozen Earth-cell using navigation only. If the resulting raw sample remains approximately 819-821, re-evaluate the already negative frozen-cell result as a stronger navigation-robust negative. If it shifts materially, inspect only the newly geometry-selected sample. No intensity-based recentering is allowed.

v2_outlier_watchlist.note: V2 used nearest raw ping at 06:22:16Z; this anchor appears outside actual raw time support and must be audited separately rather than interpreted as an ordinary navigation residual.
